forum.title: HW Version in ST33KTPM2I3WBZB1
forum.best_answer_content:
If the information were not proprietary, it would have been in the document. But it is not there, which means it is proprietary. Sorry, my previous answer is still valid.

If you like, I warmly invite you to also ask the question in the non-public and personal [Online Support OLS](https://ols.st.com).

forum.content_text:
Hello,

In the TPM part ***ST33KTPM2I3WBZB1***, what is the HW version that is supported? Is it ST33K1M5T revC or

ST33K1M5T revD?

Thanks.
forum.author: omniwiz

scraped_replies.html:
The data or information of all ST33 devices is strictly confidential and will only be handed over if an NDA is signed. For this reason, nobody in the public community will be able to help you, so you should contact your local ST contact.

Hope that helps?

Regards
/Peter
scraped_replies.author: Peter BENSCH
